subject: Request: makegood credit & short extension — onboarding paused by SSO handshake
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@heliotech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: HelioTech Engineering <engineering@heliotech.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Trial extension + runway credit request — SSO handshake blocking onboarding

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from our side — thanks again for the demo last week. We're stalled on the POC because our SAML integration with Redwood's hosted console is failing during the handshake (we see a persistent 401 at the assertion consumer). Our SREs have traced it to a metadata mismatch in the redirect URL handling; it's going to take a couple of sprints to get into our release cadence.

We were hoping Redwood could do two things to keep momentum:
- Provide a short trial extension (we need an extra 30 days to complete the SAML fix and finish our acceptance tests).
- Offer a small makegood credit to compensate for the lost demo window — this helps keep our execs comfortable as we push the roll.

I've attached the integration log and a quick diagram of our auth flow (integration-log.txt, poc-architecture.png). Our ideal outcome is a clean handoff back to production by mid-December.

Can you advise what you need from us to get approval?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering
HelioTech
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@heliotech.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial extension + runway credit request — SSO handshake blocking onboarding

Ben — forwarding HelioTech's note. They're blocked on a SAML handshake issue and asking for a trial extension + makegood credit to keep the POC alive. Attachments from the customer are included.

Proposed sales response (from my side):
- Offer a one-time $4,000 account credit applied to sandbox/hosted usage (covers tokens and minor support).
- Extend their trial access by 30 days (from current expiry).
- Ask for an updated mutual action plan with deliverables + target acceptance date; require a checkpoint demo when their SAML fix is in our staging.

Justification: HelioTech is engaged, CTO is watching the POC cadence, and the engineering blocker is not product regressions. This is a high-signal win if we keep them moving toward the pilot.

I want to be conservative but supportive — if you want a different amount or term, tell me and I'll relay. They attached logs showing the error vectors; engineering may want a short SAML handshake check.

Are you ok to approve $4k + 30 days? If so I will send the formal credit memo and updated trial expiry.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T12:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial extension + runway credit request — SSO handshake blocking onboarding

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 11:05 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — forwarding HelioTech's note. They're blocked on a SAML handshake issue and asking for a trial extension + makegood credit to keep the POC alive.
>
> Proposed sales response: Offer $4,000 credit + 30 days.

Thanks for the context. Approve the $4,000 one-time credit and 30-day extension, with two conditions:
1) We need a short joint checkpoint demo scheduled within the extension window (we'll require the demo to qualify the pilot for next-phase pricing).
2) Vanessa should capture a brief mutual action plan in HubSpot (3 milestones max) before we issue the credit.

If they push back on the conditions, escalate to me but don't exceed $4,000 or extend beyond 30 days without prior sign-off.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@heliotech.com>
Cc: HelioTech Engineering <engineering@heliotech.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Trial extension + runway credit request — SSO handshake blocking onboarding

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and the logs. Good news: we can support you.

Summary of what Redwood will provide:
- One-time $4,000 credit to be applied to your Redwood sandbox usage (credit memo attached: credit-authorization.pdf).
- 30-day trial extension starting from your current expiry (new expiry: 2026-12-20).
- We request a short checkpoint/demo during the extension window (15–30 minutes) once your SAML fix is deployed to staging.

Next steps for HelioTech:
1) Please upload a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) with target dates for the SAML fix + acceptance test. A HubSpot MAP template link is below.
2) Share a staging demo time — we'll coordinate calendar invites and a quick run-through with our integration engineer.

Attachments: credit-authorization.pdf (internal), integration-log.txt, poc-architecture.png.

If that all sounds good I'll mark the credit and extension in our billing system this morning.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive

Vanessa — perfect, thanks.

We accept the $4,000 credit and the 30-day extension. Attached is our updated MAP (HelioTech-MAP-Nov2026.pdf) with three milestones and a proposed staging demo on Dec 8. We also included an expanded log snippet showing the redirect mismatch.

Appreciate the quick help — we'll aim to have the fix merged by Dec 3 so the staging demo is meaningful.

Thanks,
